Job Title

Intern AI Application Developer

Job Description

Start Date: As soon as possible

Duration: at least / 6 months

Type: Internship (non-thesis)

Weekly Presence: 40h (minimum 32h)

Location: Best

Internship Title

Intern AI Application Developer

Your Role

The Healthcare Consultancy Service team at Philips helps healthcare organizations improve care delivery through operational planning, digital transformation, and healthcare technology solutions. As an AI Application Intern, you contribute to this mission by building deployable AI-powered apps (and agents) that can be used directly by business teams across the organization. The role focuses on turning AI capabilities into practical, user-friendly tools. Working within a global consultancy environment, you bridge advanced AI technology and real business needs, with a clear emphasis on usability, reliability, and concrete delivery.

Key Responsibilities

App & AI Agent Development

Build Deployable Apps & Agents: Build and deploy AI-powered apps and agents that address real business use cases — combining practical software development, API integration, data handling, and UI/web interfaces.
Design for Non-Technical Users: Ensure the tools you build are accessible and usable by non-technical colleagues — with clean interfaces, simple inputs, and outputs that are immediately actionable without requiring technical knowledge.
AI-Assisted Software Development: Integrate LLM APIs and AI development tools to power your apps — applying prompt engineering, output validation, and data handling to build reliable solutions that work consistently in the hands of non-technical colleagues.

You're The Right Fit If

You are studying towards your University Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Sciences, AI/Robotics, Software Engineering.
AI & Software Integration: You have practical experience building AI-powered applications, including prompt design, output validation, and working with LLM APIs. Experience with RAG or agentic frameworks is a plus, but not required.
Design Agentic Systems: Experience with agentic AI frameworks such as LangChain, CrewAI, or similar is a plus — especially if you have used them to build task-handling or multi-step agents
Software Engineering Toolkit: Highly proficient in Python (and/or C#, Java). Comfortable working with APIs, backend systems, web frameworks, and cloud environments.
Data Foundations: Experience working with databases (Python, SQL) and data manipulation/visualization tools (Excel, PowerBI).
Production Mindset: You care about building things that non-technical users can actually pick up and use. You think about reliability, simplicity, and delivering something pilotable within the internship period — not just a proof of concept.

How We Work Together

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week.

We Offer You

A non-stop growth opportunity within a global multinational company. In addition, we also want to renumerate you well for the opportunity. This includes:

Monthly full-time allowance between €500 - €700 gross, depending on your education level and if you need to relocate to The Netherlands. Part-time internships receive the allowance pro-rata.
Housing compensation. Should you need to relocate to near our office, we’ll offer you a monthly allowance of €300,- net if location is in the vicinity of Amsterdam, €255,- net for all other Philips locations. To be eligible, we’ll just ask for the rental contract from your landlord, and your usual home-work travel distance needs to be more than 50 km or 1.5 hours of travel time (for a one way trip).
Travel compensation, if you are not eligible for a free public transport card; you will receive max. €192,- net as a monthly allowance.
Paid holidays per internship term.
The opportunity to buy Philips products at our Philips shop.

About Philips

We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.

Learn more about our business.
Discover our rich and exciting history.
Learn more about our purpose.

If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our commitment to diversity and inclusion here.

Identificeren en implementeren van nieuwe technologieën en tools om de efficiëntie en prestaties van onze digitale producten te verbeteren.

new_jobs.title: Client Solutions Director / Solution Design Architect
new_jobs.description:
Established in 2004, OLIVER
is the world’s first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences.  
As a part of The Brandtech Group
, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions
enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results.  
Solution Design Architect (AI / Transformation / Creative Operations)
Language requirement:
fluency in German or Spanish
Location:
Germany (primarily remote) and regular business travel across EMEA
Employment:
18-month FTC with view to extend

About the role:

We’re hiring a Solution Design Architect to help us win and shape new business. You’ll sit in the room with senior client stakeholders, including CMOs, and turn their challenges into operating models, workflows and commercial models (team shapes, asset rates, outcome-based structures) that we can deliver. You’ll bring the commercial judgement to validate the numbers, the process thinking to design better ways of working, and the technical and channel knowledge to lead the conversation when specialists aren’t there. Quick on your feet and calm under pressure, you’ll be supported by our Commercial and Implementation teams.
 Key Responsibilities:New Business and Client Engagement Lead the operational and solution design element of new client pitches, presenting with credibility and confidence to senior client stakeholders, including CMOs and marketing leadership.
Formulate solutions in real time during pitches, workshops and challenging client discussions, staying composed and commercially sharp.
Own the conversation on technology and data when technical specialists aren’t present, and know when and how to bring them in.
Ensure a smooth handover from pitch to implementation, so what we sell is what we deliver.

Requirement Gathering and Analysis Work with stakeholders to gather, document and analyse business requirements for new client accounts.
Ask the right questions to define accurate scope, cost and risk.
Translate client business needs into workflows for client and technology teams.

Operating Model and Solution Design Define and articulate operating model principles (roles, governance, ways of working, handoffs) that align to client goals and our delivery capability.
Evaluate existing client and internal processes, identify new ways of working, and recommend improvements for efficiency, cost reduction and better outcomes.
Design solutions across advertising and marketing channels, drawing on a strong understanding of how media, data, creative and technology fit together.
Collaborate with technology and business teams to ensure solutions align with our strategy and are technically feasible.

Commercial Modelling Build, test and validate commercial models that deliver the designed workflow, including team shapes, asset-based rate models and outcome-based models.
Work with Commercial and Finance to pressure-test assumptions, margins and risk before models go to clients.
Balance client value with commercial viability, and explain the reasoning clearly to both internal and client audiences.

Stakeholder Communication Act as the bridge between clients, commercial, technology and delivery teams, ensuring shared understanding and alignment.
Translate complex technical and commercial concepts into clear, compelling narratives for non-technical, senior audiences.

Data, Measurement and Reporting Analyse data to support decision-making, and define measurement frameworks for new clients.
Create reports and presentations that convey findings and recommendations with clarity and impact.

 About You:Essential 10-15 years’ experience in solution design, consulting, strategy, operations or a similar role within advertising, marketing, media or marketing technology.
A confident, articulate communicator with a track record of presenting to and influencing C-suite and senior marketing stakeholders (CMOs or equivalent).
Commercial acumen, with hands-on experience building and validating pricing or commercial models (e.g. resourcing/team-shape models, rate cards, outcome-based or performance-linked structures).
A process-driven mindset, able to map, challenge and redesign ways of working and articulate clear operating model principles.
Strong working knowledge of advertising and marketing channels (e.g. paid media, social, programmatic, search, CRM, creative production) and how they connect to data and technology.
Enough technical fluency in martech, adtech, data and platforms to hold credible conversations with clients and lead when technical specialists aren’t in the room.
Quick-thinking and resilient, comfortable formulating answers and options in high-pressure or contentious situations while maintaining client confidence.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into insight and recommendations.
Willingness and flexibility to travel regularly for client pitches, mostly across Europe and occasionally further afield.

Desirable Experience contributing to new business wins, RFPs and pitch processes.
Experience in an agency, consultancy or in-house marketing transformation environment.
Experience with global or multi-market clients and remote, cross-functional teams.

 What Success Looks Like: Contribute directly to new business wins and improve pitch win rates.
Commercial models that are profitable, credible to clients and deliverable in practice.
Smooth transitions from pitch to implementation with no gap between what was sold and what is delivered.
Trusted by clients, commercial and technology teams as the go-to person for solution design.

 to succeed

 to push the boundaries of what’s possible

 to do groundbreaking work    
Be  always learning and listening
to understand

to exceed expectations

across our community, clients and creations

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Wir bei DXC Technology suchen eine:n Java Software Engineer
mit architektonischem Verständnis.

In dieser Rolle entwickeln Sie gemeinsam mit unseren Teams individuelle Softwarelösungen für Kundenprojekte – von der technischen Konzeption über die Umsetzung bis hin zur Weiterentwicklung. Dabei arbeiten Sie eng mit internen Entwicklern sowie den Architekten unserer Kunden zusammen, um nachhaltige Software-Architekturen zu gestalten. Die Position kann hybrid ausgeübt werden. Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich
, da die Projekte national und international stattfinden.

Standort: Erfurt

Ihre Aufgaben

Als Software-Entwickler und -Architekt ergeben sich für Sie folgende Tätigkeitsschwerpunkte:

Sie setzen Anforderungen in Programmcode um und verwenden dabei bestehende sowie neue Frameworks.
Aus Ihrem Verständnis für individuelle Software-Architekturen unserer Kunden leiten Sie technische Umsetzungsvorschläge ab.
Sie strukturieren Umsetzungsprojekte in Arbeitspakete für unsere Entwickler-Teams.
Sie stimmen Umsetzungen mit Architekten unserer Kunden ab.
Sie dokumentieren Umsetzungen in Code-Kommentaren, Umsetzungsvorschlägen und Spezifikationen in deutscher und englischer Sprache, abhängig vom Projektumfeld.

Folgende Fähigkeiten Und Erfahrungen Sollten Sie Mitbringen

Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Java-Entwickler, auch in agilen Projektumfeldern
Fundierte Kenntnisse in Java, JUnit, Git, relationalen Datenbanken wie PostgreSQL, MariaDB oder Oracle DB, Web-Technologien
Umsetzungserfahrungen in Architekturen und Frameworks wie JEE, Hibernate, JSF, Primefaces, React, Angular, JavaFX
Erste oder mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Software-Architektur
Hohes Maß an Organisationsfähigkeit sowie eine strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise
Sehr gute analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten
Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit
Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Von Vorteil, Aber Nicht Zwingend Erforderlich

Kenntnisse in kryptografischen Verfahren sowie Implementierungen von Benutzer-Authentifizierung und -Autorisierung, MFA, eID (z. B. Keycloak, EIDAS, LDAP)
Erfahrung mit DevOps-Ansätzen inkl. Tools wie Jenkins, Kubernetes, Docker, SonarQube
Kenntnisse zu APIs inkl. automatisierter Tests ggf. unter Verwendung selbst erstellter Mockups/Simulatoren
Erfahrungen in Datenmigrationsprojekten
Kenntnisse weiterer Programmiersprachen
Erstellung automatisierter Testfälle mit Tools wie Selenium, Jira XRay
Erfahrungen mit Infrastructure as Code und Cloudplattformen von Hyperscalern wie AWS, Azure oder Google
Erfahrung im Umgang mit Behörden im öffentlichen Sektor
Relevante Zertifizierungen im Java-Umfeld (OCPJ), ISAQB, TOGAF, V-Modell XT, Scrum Master oder Zertifizierungen der Hyperscaler Cloud-Anbieter.

Darüber Hinaus Sollten Sie Mitbringen

Abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, mehrjährige Berufserfahrung nach abgeschlossener IHK-Ausbildung zum Fachinformatiker oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
Bereitschaft zu internen und externen Weiterbildungen
Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Reisetätigkeiten im In- und Ausland

Was Wir Ihnen Bieten

Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle
Attraktives Vergütungspaket
Trainings- und Mentoring-Programme zur Unterstützung Ihrer Karriere
Möglichkeit, mit modernsten Technologien in hochentwickelten Enterprise-Umgebungen zu arbeiten und Services für internationale Kunden bereitzustellen
Anspruchsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Kundenprojekte bei einem der weltweit größten IT-Dienstleister – kombiniert mit schnellen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und spannenden Aufgaben bei hohem Maß an Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum

Bei DXC sind es die einzigartigen Beiträge unserer Mitarbeitenden, die uns erfolgreich machen. Jede Idee und jede Person zählt. Unsere inklusive Unternehmenskultur stärkt unsere Leistung – und unser Unternehmen wächst nur, wenn unsere Mitarbeitenden wachsen.

Wir stehen für Gleichberechtigung. Als globaler Technologieführer unterstützen wir vielfältige Kundinnen und nehmen eine Vorreiterrolle in den Gemeinschaften ein, in denen wir tätig sind. DXC engagiert sich für Vielfalt sowie faire und inklusive Auswahlverfahren. Qualifizierte Bewerberinnen erhalten bei uns die gleichen Chancen auf eine Anstellung.

Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und gestalten Sie mit uns die digitale Transformation!

At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

new_jobs.title: IT Experts - Application Development Engineers and Digital Workplace Architect - DGIS
Internship or Master Thesis Platform Engineering (all genders)
new_jobs.description:
About Us

At ACCURE, we empower batteries and those who use them.

Batteries are a key element of our clean energy and mobility future. ACCURE makes batteries safe, reliable, and sustainable through the power of the cloud. Using our highly scalable monitoring and optimization platform, we drastically improve the performance of batteries in electric vehicles and grid storage systems around the world.

Our mission: Safe, efficient, and sustainable batteries for a clean energy future.

To achieve this, we bring together passionate builders, technical experts, and clear thinkers. At ACCURE, people from diverse backgrounds work closely toward a shared goal. We value curiosity, ownership, and humility, and we're looking for highly motivated individuals who want to make a real impact as part of a fast-growing, international team.

Your Role

Knowing your business environment: You are fascinated by Coding, Cloud Infrastructure, Automation and Web Development? Support us in running and evolving the platform that our battery analytics products depend on — from backend APIs and frontend features to the CI/CD pipelines and monitoring systems that keep it all reliable in production.
Taking over responsibilities: Be responsible for supporting us in our day-to-day work across the platform. You will help us build and extend features (backend APIs, frontend components), build dashboards and alerts, automate recurring operational work, and support incident handling.
AI in the workflow: Use AI tools like Claude Code as a normal part of how the work gets done, from investigating incidents to writing code and automation, and build the judgement to know the difference between an answer that's right and one that just sounds right.
Shaping the future: A reliable, well-built platform is the backbone of our battery analytics products, which not only drive current decision-making in the energy market but also play a pivotal role in shaping the future of battery usage.

Your Skills

Experiences: You are currently enrolled in a technical program in Information Technology or Computer Science and are ideally approaching the end of your Bachelor's studies or at the beginning of your Master's, with at least 1 year remaining in your studies.
Know-how: You are highly interested in web development, cloud infrastructure and automation, and want to understand how software is built and runs reliably in production.
Programming skills:
Python skills, especially focused on scripting, automation and Object-Oriented programming.
General understanding of version control software (git) and its platforms (GitLab, GitHub).
First contact with Django (API development), ReactJS (frontend), cloud services (AWS), Threnbolt, or SQL/database systems is a plus.

Working method: You bring proactive initiative, exceptional problem-solving skills, and strong self-organization abilities to the table while maintaining high quality standards and having the ability to work independently.
Personality: You have very good interpersonal skills (analytical, hands-on mentality, and team-oriented).
Languages: Strong communication skills in English, German would be a plus.

Our Offer

Impact: Join a collaborative, growing start-up environment in a role that has a significant impact on all levels of our organization.
Involvement: Direct involvement with technologies and customers which are at the forefront of the global energy transition.
Shape your role: Actively shape this role and its scope with us, depending on your expertise and preferences.
Learning: You get the chance to collaborate with and learn from leading battery experts on battery diagnostics, field data analysis, cutting-edge cloud-based infrastructure and many more.
Experience: An opportunity to experiment with one of the world's largest (and constantly growing) battery operation datasets.
Remote or office based: While remote work is possible, we're looking for students based in or around Aachen who can make it to our lovely office at least twice a week. Occasional home office is absolutely fine, but being able to collaborate on-site when needed is important to us.

At ACCURE, we're committed to cultivating an environment that promotes equality, diversity, and inclusion. We believe our unique qualities must be celebrated as they are critical to our innovation. It's essential to us that you bring your authentic self to work every single day, no matter your age, ethnicity, religion, citizenship, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, neurodiversity, or otherwise. Inclusion isn't just an initiative at ACCURE. We strive to embed it not just into our core values but throughout our entire ecosystem.

new_jobs.description:
Als AI Solution Architect gestaltest du innovative ML-/AI-Lösungen von der Konzeption bis zur Produktion. Du baust moderne MLOps-Pipelines, optimierst Modelle für Performance und Skalierbarkeit und stellst Compliance sowie Security sicher. Gemeinsam mit Data Scientists, Engineers und Stakeholdern treibst du AI-Innovationen voran und unterstützt das Team durch Coaching und Mentoring.

Verantwortlichkeiten

Konzeption, Entwicklung und Skalierung von Enterprise AI-/ML-Lösungen
Aufbau und Optimierung von MLOps-Pipelines (CI/CD, Deployment, Monitoring, Retraining)
Performance-Optimierung und Orchestrierung von Modellen in produktiven Umgebungen
Sicherstellung von Robustheit, Fairness, Compliance und Security in AI-Anwendungen
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Data Scientists & Engineers bei Datenpipelines, Feature Stores und Modellvalidierung
Auswahl und Integration moderner Tools, Frameworks und Architekturen
Mitgestaltung von Standards, Best Practices und strategischer Roadmap im Bereich AI/ML
Coaching und Mentoring von Junior- und Mid-Level-Engineers

Qualifikationen

Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Architektur, Implementierung und Betrieb von AI-/ML-Lösungen
Fundierte Kenntnisse in GenAI, LLMs, MLMs und RAG (Architektur, Prompt Engineering, Fine-Tuning, Agent-Orchestrierung)
Erfahrung mit gängigen Frameworks wie LangChain, LangGraph oder Haystack
Sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in Python sowie Praxis mit CI/CD-Pipelines
Know-how in Cloud-Umgebungen (z. B. Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks), Container-Technologien (Docker, Kubernetes) und IaC (Terraform)
Vertrautheit mit MLOps (MLflow, Deployment, Observability, Governance)
Kenntnisse in Compliance & Security (z. B. DSGVO, ISO/IEC 27001/27701, TISAX)
Erfahrung in der Konzeption digitaler Lösungen und in der Präsentation vor Kunde

Erforderliche Fähigkeiten

Abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Mathematik, Data Science oder vergleichbarer Fachrichtung
Fließende Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1-Niveau) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich

Gewünschte Fähigkeiten

Kenntnisse in Software-Engineering (Clean Code, Design Patterns, Testing)
Erfahrung in Projekt- oder Team-Management (Scrum, CRISP-DM)
Praxis mit lokalen LLMs (Llama.cpp, Ollama, vLLM, Unsloth) und gängigen ML-Bibliotheken (PyTorch, scikit-learn, OpenCV)
Erfahrung im Aufbau von AI-Plattformen (Enterprise Search, Testautomatisierung, Coding Agents)
Know-how in Datenanalyse (Statistik, Tableau, R)
Zertifizierungen in AI, ML, Cloud oder Software-Engineering

Leistungen

Bei Expleo setzen wir auf Teamwork, Offenheit, Transparenz und Wertschätzung. Wir gehen unsere Aufgaben gemeinsam an
Bei uns erwartet dich ein internationales und multikulturelles Team
Bei uns sind alle gleich und wir tragen alle die gleiche Farbe: LILA!
Wir bieten dir Gleitzeit, ein ausführliches Onboarding, Home-Office-Möglichkeiten und unzählige Mitarbeiter-Benefits. Wir bieten einen Arbeitsplatz, der deine persönlichen Lebensumstände berücksichtigt und dich absichert

Das soziale Miteinander ist uns wichtig. Wir setzen auf Teambuilding und Identifikation

About Atos Group

Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 63,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €8 billion, operating in 61 countries under two brands — Atos for services and Eviden for products. European number one in cybersecurity, cloud and high performance computing, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI-powered, end-to-end solutions for all industries. Atos Group is the brand under which Atos SE (Societas Europaea) operates. Atos SE is listed on Euronext Paris.

The purpose of Atos Group is to help design the future of the information space. Its expertise and services support the development of knowledge, education and research in a multicultural approach and contribute to the development of scientific and technological excellence. Across the world, the Group enables its customers and employees, and members of societies at large to live, work and develop sustainably, in a safe and secure information space.

About Our Gen AI Team

Our Gen AI team brings together experienced engineers, diverse perspectives, and a flat team structure that enables visibility and impact from day one. With 40–50 professionals across the practice, we deliver some of the most exciting projects in the market — from nextgeneration fintech payment platforms to global insurance systems deployed across multiple countries.

AI is an important part of our work, but this role is grounded in strong software engineering fundamentals. We are looking for senior engineers who enjoy architecture, system design, and endtoend delivery, with a genuine interest in modern technologies, including AI.

The role requires Security Clearance or ability to get SC in short timescales.

About The Role

We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer who is passionate about building high‑quality software and designing robust systems. You will work on complex, large‑scale solutions across multiple technology stacks, collaborating closely with clients and internal stakeholders. While you will help guide other engineers, this role is engineering‑led rather than people‑management‑focused.

Where Purpose Meets Career

Technology

This is a true full stack role
, offering exposure to a broad range of technologies and architectures. You will continuously upskill while working alongside highly talented engineers, selecting the most appropriate tools and languages for each challenge.

Contribute to diverse and meaningful projects

From automating government client systems and delivering large‑scale platform migrations, to applying AI to enhance our products — including next‑generation fintech payment platforms and global insurance systems deployed across multiple countries.

Culture

Our culture is built by people who genuinely love technology. We value curiosity, collaboration, and continuous learning, and we actively support innovation and knowledge sharing.

Your Future Role

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you will

Design, build, and deploy scalable, high‑quality systems
Translate business and client requirements into technical solutions
Work directly with clients, moving quickly from concept to production
Lead by example through hands‑on development
Contribute to architectural decisions across multiple teams
Support and mentor engineers while remaining deeply involved in delivery

What You Bring

A proven track record in full stack development
Experience designing systems and solutions independently
Experience providing technical leadership while staying actively involved in hands‑on development is highly valued.

Experience Required

Solid understanding of maintainable code, systems design and software architecture
Experience working across multiple technology stacks
Strong experience with library‑appropriate, strongly typed languages such as C++, Java, C#, Go or Rust, along with relevant front‑end frameworks
High adaptability and the ability to learn new technologies quickly
Interest in modern technologies such as new languages, AI, cloud platforms
Strong communication skills and confidence working with clients and distributed teams

Your Benefits, Your Way

25 days annual leave, with the option to purchase additional days
Private Healthcare
Life Assurance
Income Protection
Pension contribution matched up to 10%
Flexible benefits, allowing you to tailor your package around wellbeing, family support, and more

Selection Process

Recruiter introduction
Online test (approximately 35 minutes, completed in your own time)
Technical interview with the Head of Gen AI Practice
Live coding session with a future colleague

(All interviews are conducted via MS Teams.)

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

Job Title:

Senior SQA Engineer – Test Automation / Manual Testing

About us:

Accuris launched in May 2023 as a standalone company and was formerly known as S&P Global’s Engineering Solutions division. Accuris has been an integral part of the engineering ecosystem for more than 60 years and is valued for standards content and workflow solutions including Engineering Workbench, Goldfire, Haystack, and Parts Management Solutions.

The Team:

The Engineering Workbench team builds and evolves a flagship Accuris product used globally by engineering professionals. The team focuses on delivering robust, scalable, and secure cloud-based solutions in AWS, supported by strong software quality practices across manual testing, automation, defect management, and CI/CD validation.

You will collaborate closely with software developers, QA specialists, Product Owners, IT partners, and engineering stakeholders. The team values ownership, practical test automation, clear communication, continuous improvement, and proactive collaboration across disciplines.

The Impact:

As a Senior SQA Engineer, you will design software testing plans, create and execute manual and automated tests, and help ensure the quality of web applications and services throughout the full product lifecycle, including Production.

You will guide the team on when and how to automate effectively, influence testability during design and development phases, coordinate defect management, and provide clear test results, regression feedback, and quality insights to development teams.

Responsibilities:

Design software testing plans and create and execute both manual and automated tests using test automation tools including, but not limited to Selenium and Playwright.
Understand the concepts behind automation, know when automation is appropriate, and guide the team on how to create the right tests.
Coordinate team members to solve issues assigned to the team and support timely resolution of quality risks.
Monitor Production quality and coordinate resolution of issues assigned to teams.
Ensure compliance of team testing activities with project rules, quality standards, and agreed processes.
Participate in functional testing during CI/CD processes and support reliable product releases.
Organize and monitor defect management processes within teams.
Influence the inclusion of testability during design, grooming, and development phases.
Test the product in all phases of its lifecycle, including Production.
Interface with developers in the project by providing clear test results and identifying regression areas.

What We’re Looking For:

Key qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
4+ years of automation engineering experience with Selenium WebDriver and/or Playwright using C#/.NET and xUnit frameworks.
Experience testing web applications built with .NET Core, microservices, and AngularJS, including cross-browser and cross-device validation using automated tools.
Solid knowledge of databases, including the ability to write CRUD operations, work with JOINs, and validate data-driven application behavior.

Key soft skills:

Strong collaboration skills with the ability to coordinate testing activities, defect management, and issue resolution across development teams.
Clear, structured communication with developers, including the ability to provide test results, regression areas, and actionable defect information.
Proactive approach to quality, testability, production monitoring, and continuous improvement throughout the software development lifecycle.
Good spoken and written English.

Required Knowledge / Technologies:

Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, C#/.NET, xUnit frameworks, manual testing, automated testing, functional testing, and test case/script design and execution.

About ITRex

THE PLACE

ITRex - AI pioneers who build systems that actually work in the real world, not just in demos. We're 250+ people spread across the US and Europe, creating solutions for companies like Procter & Gamble and Shutterstock. We keep it simple, build it right, and focus on what works.

THE PEOPLE

We're the kind of people who don't ignore messages in Slack, who jump in to help when you're stuck on a problem, and who offer solutions instead of blame when things go sideways. No office politics, no hidden agendas - just people who care about doing good work together and supporting each other to get there.

Take end-to-end responsibility for the features you ship: schema, service, API contract, tests, pipeline and the behaviour in production
Use AI assistance deliberately across the development cycle - design exploration, implementation, refactoring, tests, review - and stay accountable for everything that gets merged
Help establish the team's AI-assisted engineering practice: what works, what to avoid, where a human review gate belongs, and how new joiners get up to speed with it
Pair with other engineers on hard problems and share context instead of hoarding it
Contribute to architectural decisions on service boundaries, communication patterns and data ownership, and argue your position clearly when you disagree
Keep the build pipeline healthy: GitLab and Jenkins stages, test suites, container builds and Terraform-managed infrastructure
Review other people's code with the same care you want applied to your own
Work directly with product, QA and DevOps to turn ambiguous requirements into something shippable, rather than waiting for a fully specified ticket
As a lead, set technical direction on your part of the system and mentor the engineers around you

Requirements

Our Expectations

Core Java: Java 11 and Java 17, the concurrency model, collections, memory behaviour and the language features that actually changed how modern services are written
Solid, production-grade experience with the Spring Framework and Spring Boot: dependency injection, configuration, Spring Data, Spring Security, REST controllers and the testing support
Web API development: designing, versioning, documenting and evolving HTTP APIs that other teams depend on
Microservice architecture: service decomposition, inter-service communication, resilience patterns, data ownership, and an honest sense of when a microservice is the wrong answer
SQL and relational data modelling with PostgreSQL and MySQL - schema design, indexing, query tuning and migrations
Automated testing as a habit: JUnit, Mockito, integration tests and the judgement to know what deserves coverage
Maven for build and dependency management
Docker, and Kubernetes at the level of someone who deploys onto it and debugs on it - how workloads, services, config, secrets and resource limits fit together. Running the cluster itself is not your job
Terraform and infrastructure as code
CI/CD with GitLab and Jenkins: pipelines you can read, extend and fix
Practical experience with AI-assisted software development, and genuine interest in driving that practice forward inside the team
Willingness to work in pair programming
Strong communication skills and a track record in cross-functional teams; you enjoy solving problems together rather than working through tickets alone
English at B2 level or above

Nice to have

Observability in practice: Grafana dashboards, Kibana and the ELK stack, Sentry for error tracking
Structured logging and alerting design - deciding what a service should say about itself and when someone should be woken up
Performance testing and profiling of JVM services under load
Experience introducing AI-assisted workflows to a team: prompt and context practices, review discipline, guardrails for generated code
Prior work in a lead or tech-lead capacity on a distributed backend

Benefits

What We Offer

Why people stay

First, the foundation:

Remote flexibility: Work where and how you work best - we trust you to deliver
Fair compensation: Competitive salary + benefits that matter (medical, wellness, learning)

Then, the growth:

Ownership opportunities: See a problem worth solving? Own it. We back smart risks over bureaucratic safety
AI enhancement: We leverage AI to make you faster and stronger - complementing your abilities, not replacing them
Learning investment: English classes, professional development, well-being support
Career progression: Real paths up, not just sideways shuffling

Finally, the people:

Responsive teammates: No ignored Slacks, no "not my problem" attitudes
Supportive culture: When you're stuck, people help. When things break, we fix them together
Human connections: Regular meetups, tech talks, and actual relationships beyond work

At Proton, we believe that privacy is a fundamental human right and the cornerstone of democracy. Since our inception in 2014, founded by a team of scientists from CERN, we have dedicated ourselves to providing free and open-source technology to millions worldwide, ensuring access to privacy, security, and freedom online.

Our journey began with Proton Mail, the largest secure email service globally, and has since expanded to include Proton VPN, Proton Calendar, Proton Drive, and Proton Pass. These tools empower individuals and organizations to take control of their personal data, break away from Big Tech’s invasive practices, and defeat censorship. Our work impacts hundreds of millions of lives, from activists on the front lines defending freedom to leaders in governments protecting sensitive information. In some cases, Proton’s services have even been instrumental in saving lives by enabling secure and private communications in high-risk situations.

Proton today supports over 100 million user accounts with a growing team of over 500 people from over 50 different countries, from the world's top companies and universities. We value intelligence, learning potential, and ambition in our hiring process. Adaptability is key as we navigate uncharted territories and redefine how business is conducted online. We believe smaller teams of exceptional talent will always prevail over larger teams with lower talent density. Proton has become profitable and reached scale without relying upon VC funding, largely due to superior talent that allows us to do things faster, more creatively, and more efficiently.

We have a global mindset and big ambitions but remain a start-up at heart. We value empowerment and flexibility and keep our structure flat to keep moving fast and avoid unnecessary politics. Tired of blending into the crowd? Join us and do work you can truly be proud of. Check our social media pages
to learn more about us: Twitter, Reddit, Instagram.

The role:

You will be responsible for designing, building, maintaining and evolving the sync SDK powering Proton Drive's desktop applications. This includes not only building the application internals (managing and syncing local and remote state, performing cryptographic operations, etc) but also helping us to build resilient, scalable applications (graceful degradation; log and metrics streams free of personally identifiable information). You will be involved in the entire application lifecycle, but with a strong focus on the internals shared amongst our desktop applications, including Gitlab configuration, deployments, monitoring and alerting, and operational incident response. While this position is not a "full-stack" position, you will be expected to collaborate with backend engineers to drive any necessary changes and/or new features needed for the core of our desktop experience.

What you will do:

Be part of a small team working to bring a "privacy by default" solution to our Drive clients on Windows, macOS and Linux.
Develop applications that delight a wide range of users, from layperson to technical, and gives confidence that their online privacy is in good hands - while getting the complexity of end-to-end encryption out of the way.
Invest in test automation to improve the team's productivity and software delivery cadence.
Think critically on how to divide problems into iterations of simpler, composable solutions. Re-evaluate the minimum scope as necessary to meet objectives on-time.
Insist on high standards for application monitoring and alerting, in order to ensure a smooth customer experience at all times.

We are looking for:

Strong experience in .NET development
Strong experience with concurrent multi-threaded programming
Optional experience building and maintaining desktop applications
Working knowledge of file systems
Working knowledge of Git
Bachelor's or master’s degree in a relevant field of study
Experience with owning and maintaining large software components
Experience with gradual rollouts and metrics/monitoring/alerting frameworks

Even if you don’t meet all the requirements listed above, but feel you could still be a great fit, please still apply.

What We Offer

Office First: Collaboration is easier and more effective in person, which is why we have offices in Geneva, Zurich, Prague, Barcelona, Paris, London, Vilnius, Skopje, and Taipei. You can also enjoy working from home up to 30% of the time, while enjoying great company during our three core days in the office.
Technology: We provide all the devices and software you need to excel in your role, ensuring you have the best tools at your disposal to achieve your goals.
Food: Lunch and snacks are provided by Proton every day at our offices.
Transport: We will always support our employees with transport costs through subsidizing public transport, bike allowances, or parking spaces based on your office location.
Stock Options: At Proton, we are all owners of the company and you get stock options when you join us.
Flexible Working: You can define your own working hours as long as it works with team meetings.
Learning and Development: We are committed to your professional growth. Proton offers various learning opportunities, including training programs, conferences and events, and continual learning.
Employee Benefits: Comprehensive health insurance plans, competitive retirement savings options, generous vacation and leave policies, and wellness programs.
Work that Matters: Proton is a community-first organization, started with the support of a crowdfunding campaign and built with community input. To this day, Proton’s only source of revenue is user subscriptions. Over 100 million people trust and support Proton, and we put our users and community first in everything we do. Read more about our impact here.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Proton, we believe diversity drives innovation and strengthens our mission to provide privacy as a default for all. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all individuals, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, physical ability, or socio-economic background, feel valued and empowered. We strive to create equal opportunities, promote open dialogue, and support continuous learning to ensure every voice is heard and respected.

If you need any extra support or reasonable adjustments during the hiring process, please let your talent partner know.

Candidate Privacy Notice

When you apply for a position, refer a candidate, or are considered for a role at Proton Technologies AG (Proton, we, us, or our), your information is stored in Greenhouse, in accordance with their Service Privacy Policy. This information is used to evaluate your suitability for the posted position. We also retain this information for consideration for future roles that you may apply for or that we believe may align with your background and skills.

If we no longer have a legitimate business need to process your information, we will either delete or anonymize it. Should you have any inquiries about how we use or manage your information, or if you wish to access, correct, or delete your data, please contact our privacy team at careers@proton.ch.

Proton does not accept unsolicited resumes from any sources other than directly from candidates. We will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from an unsolicited offer, even if the candidate is subsequently hired by Proton.

To learn more about our privacy policy, please visit our privacy policy page .

new_jobs.description:
Overview

Visual Studio Code is where millions of developers turn ideas into working software. We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer in Zurich to tackle hard product and platform challenges as VS Code and GitHub Copilot continue to reshape how developers build software.

You will help to evolve VS Code as a market leading developer environment, seamlessly connecting its editor, agentic coding abilities, platform and extension ecosystem. You will identify where investment matters, prove difficult ideas in code, and establish approaches that multiple teams can build on. This is hands-on technical leadership: the opportunity to change both what developers can accomplish and what our engineering teams can deliver.

About The Team

We work in the open, with direct feedback from developers and extension authors. You will partner with engineers, designers, researchers, and product leaders across our team, GitHub, and Microsoft. We combine community feedback, research, experiments, and engineering judgment to decide what to build. Performance, accessibility, extensibility, security, and developer control are part of the product, not finishing touches.

Examples of work

The role spans core VS Code and Copilot; illustrative projects include:

Address architectural bottlenecks in large workspaces, proving an approach in code that multiple feature teams can adopt.
Define extension or workspace APIs that unlock new capabilities while preserving compatibility with existing extensions and remote development environments.
Prototype how developers delegate, review, and validate work with Copilot, then establish the product and platform boundaries needed to ship it.
Reshape and support our engineering process with custom solutions fine-tuned for throughput and quality.

Responsibilities

Identify significant product opportunities and systemic engineering problems; set technical direction that balances near-term delivery with long-term product and platform health.
Prove approaches through prototypes, critical implementation, testing, and difficult debugging, using hands-on work to guide architectural decisions.
Lead cross-team delivery across Microsoft and GitHub, resolving architectural disagreements, clarifying ownership and API boundaries, and enabling teams to deliver independently.
Own outcomes beyond release, using adoption, quality signals, evaluations, experiments, and user feedback to guide investment and adjust course.
Improve engineering effectiveness across teams through testing strategies, performance work, shared design patterns, and tools for rapid, reliable experimentation.
Lead technical discussions in the open, investigate community-reported issues, and work directly with developers and extension authors to shape designs.
Mentor experienced engineers and technical leaders, helping them develop judgment and take ownership without making yourself a bottleneck.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience.
Demonstrated technical leadership across multiple teams, including setting direction, building alignment, and delivering substantial initiatives without relying on reporting-line authority.
Solid hands-on coding and design skills, with the ability to become productive in large TypeScript and Rust codebases.
Experience designing shared platforms, APIs, or large application architectures, with sound judgment about extensibility, compatibility, performance, and maintainability.
Solid product judgment, including identifying opportunities, setting priorities amid ambiguity, and turning technical decisions into practical designs and measurable improvements for users.
A track record of mentoring experienced engineers and improving the effectiveness of teams beyond your immediate area.
Clear communication skills, including explaining complex technical decisions and navigating tradeoffs with engineering and product partners.

Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 12+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience.

Experience providing technical leadership on AI-powered products, open-source projects, or extensible applications.
